theme_brief: PILOT v3 (spike) scene-14 cue 'night to dawn' from the 26 Nov sound review: tanpura drone on D under the voice, solo esraj alap in raga Lalit's pre-dawn mood (komal Re for shame), a hushed consonant sunrise phrase; no percussion, sitar, flute or sub-bass. Nine 60 s stems (2 drone, 4 esraj, 3 sunrise seeds); assembled locally to the cut times with silence at the shame cut.
